title: Stationfall Manual
summary: Board stations with oxygen, pressure repair, panic control, and a clean exit route.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: Stationfall compresses survival into enclosed spaces. Oxygen, pressure, signal panic, access, and return routes matter more than raw loot speed.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Carry oxygen, a seal kit, a panic counter if available, food, and a clearly marked exit before treating the station as a salvage site.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Board, stabilize pressure or oxygen, gather one objective, watch panic, unlock access deliberately, and leave while reserves are still comfortable.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Access cards, pressure seal kits, oxygen packs, AI override chips, panic dampeners, and station route services all shape how long you can stay.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: Orbital Remnants shares away-route logic, Recovery helps after a failed boarding, Terminal can track station records, and TutorialCore can warn about oxygen mistakes.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If station runs collapse, lower your objective count. Add oxygen and repair margin, mark exits, and leave earlier than instinct says.
